feedStart refuses when phase is not IDLE or the servo is not ready

jobRemaining is decremented exactly once per portion
at the end of the 300 ms settle phase

span.p:
finishFeed closes the servo and measures distance
scheduled job publishes state scheduled_feed then telemetry
manual job publishes telemetry then ack ok
